definition: Pleasantly suited to someone's character, tastes, or circumstances.
author: Ann Ward Radcliffe
quote: Ah why did Fate his steps decoy In stormy paths to roam, Remote from all congenial joy!
example_sentence: We found a congenial little pub near the harbour.
